headline: Executive order creates the USA Freedom Corps, a federal effort tied to volunteer and public service.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new federal body called the USA Freedom Corps. No summary was provided, so the details of its structure, duties, and funding are not described here. The order's title indicates it creates the Corps, which is generally understood as a White House effort to encourage volunteer service.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and White House staff
who_it_affects.how: They may be asked to help set up or work with the new USA Freedom Corps.

who_it_affects.group: People interested in volunteer or public service
who_it_affects.how: They may see new or better-organized federal service opportunities, though the specifics are not given in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 29, 2002; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
